rules.summary_zh: 申请入口与专业要求分开核对
rules.audience: 申请授课型硕士
rules.statement: Use the official online application route and check the selected programme's requirements and intake.
rules.qualifications: 不要把一个专业的截止日当全校共同日期。

rules.summary_zh: 按offer确认接受要求
rules.audience: 已经收到相应offer的TPG申请人
rules.statement: Follow the conditions and acceptance arrangements in the actual admission offer.
rules.qualifications: 官方已有接受offer流程图入口，但图中步骤本轮未取得；不自行补造固定金额、时限或按钮。

rules.summary_zh: 录取与签证审批分开
rules.audience: 需要学生签证/入境许可的非本地申请人
rules.statement: An admission offer does not replace the applicable student visa or entry permit procedure.
rules.qualifications: 按身份与课程类别选SGS/ADMO相关通道；不访问个人审批账户。

rules.summary_zh: 办理周期不构成获批承诺
rules.audience: 适用签证担保流程的申请人
rules.statement: Prepare the required sponsorship documents and allow for processing; approval remains a separate outcome.
rules.qualifications: 处理周期、建议提前量、材料补交与个人结果是不同字段；不生成必批或具体到期承诺。

rules.summary_zh: 按入学届别与PCLL身份选条例，近似路径本轮正文相同
rules.audience: TPG；PCLL及不同入学届别须另核对
rules.statement: The main text applies before 2022/23 or from 2024/25 onward, and to all PCLL students; other 2022/23–Summer 2024 entrants use separately linked regulations.
rules.qualifications: 主文本自2024/25生效；两路径本轮提取正文SHA相同，不代表所有历史版本相同。2022/23至Summer2024非PCLL专用PDF未取得；该范围仍不得据主文本细则判断。

rules.summary_zh: 休学与退学分流
rules.audience: TPG，个人状态与条件需补齐
rules.statement: Leave of absence and withdrawal of studies are different procedures with separate conditions and consequences.
rules.qualifications: 休学申请由学术单位Head审批，回执不等于批准，决定后在AIMS查看结果；退学按正式通知规则生效。两者的课程、费用、住宿及签证后果分别核。

rules.summary_zh: 停止上课不代表手续完成
rules.audience: 需要退学的TPG
rules.statement: Use the prescribed withdrawal procedure and separately check outstanding obligations.
rules.qualifications: 申请、学校处理结果、课程状态及退款是不同结果；不替学生提交申请。

rules.summary_zh: 按对应缴费表与个人账单核对
rules.audience: TPG；当前学年和收费口径必须明确
rules.statement: Check the applicable payment schedule and the student's own fee statement for the amount and due date.
rules.qualifications: 不从公开政策推定个人欠款；不使用研究快照中的错误academic_year元数据。

rules.summary_zh: 退课退学与退款分别判断
rules.audience: TPG；须看课程及获准例外
rules.statement: Withdrawing from a course or programme does not by itself establish a right to a tuition refund.
rules.qualifications: 须核对适用条款、例外及学校决定；不概括成所有情况一律不退。

rules.summary_zh: 硕士住宿渠道及结果分开
rules.audience: 2026/27全日制硕士；具体课程仍待确认
rules.statement: Check the master's housing channel and conditions; an application or eligibility does not establish an allocation.
rules.qualifications: 不能套用UG首年/首两年优先权；普通与共享单位渠道、地点及确认阶段分开。

rules.summary_zh: 住宿总览旧参考价与当年专表须分别核实
rules.audience: 需要核对2026/27硕士住宿费用者
rules.statement: A previous-year reference fee is not confirmation of the current housing fee.
rules.qualifications: S22的2026/27专表现已取得全文；S10总览仍保留旧年参考价。按资助类别及费种选择对应专表，旧价不覆盖当年专表，个人应付额仍核实际offer／账单。

rules.summary_zh: PG普通借期120日、累计720日；ILL为30日／90日
rules.audience: 图书馆可续借资料；按用户及资料类别核对
rules.statement: For PG borrowers, normal loans have a 120-day loan period and 720-day maximum renewal period; ILL+HKALL uses 30 and 90 days respectively.
rules.qualifications: 以S24对应借阅人／资料行适用为前提；累计从首次借出计，召回可提前到期，不将次数不限解释为无限借期。S11入门指南没有本表；不是所有用户都用PG额度。

rules.summary_zh: 召回新日期覆盖原日期
rules.audience: 收到资料召回通知的借阅者
rules.statement: A recall notice's new due date supersedes the previous due date.
rules.qualifications: 个人实际到期日须由用户自行查通知/账户；系统不索取账号密码或OTP。

rules.summary_zh: 馆际互借按专门规则归还续借
rules.audience: ILL/HKALL或海外馆资料借阅者
rules.statement: Use the interlibrary-loan return and renewal rules, including any lending-library approval requirement.
rules.qualifications: 不套用普通还书箱或普通续借流程；具体材料类别和审批结果待查。

rules.summary_zh: 奖项渠道并不统一
rules.audience: 已选定具体奖项的学生
rules.statement: Determine whether the award uses automatic consideration, nomination or an open application.
rules.qualifications: 概述中的无须另行申请仅适用于对应奖项类型；不得推广至所有奖助学金。

rules.summary_zh: 资格按具体奖项逐项判断
rules.audience: 须明确学位、年级、local状态及资助类别
rules.statement: Check the selected award's own eligibility and current call before taking an application step.
rules.qualifications: UG、local或非毕业年专属条件不能扩展到非本地TPG；提名不等于获奖。

rules.summary_zh: 常规经济援助与紧急援助分流
rules.audience: 以所选scheme列出的身份为限
rules.statement: Distinguish regular financial assistance from emergency assistance and verify the scheme's audience.
rules.qualifications: 概述的full-time local条件不证明非本地TPG适用；惯常月份不是当年开放证明。

rules.summary_zh: 日期须匹配学年学期与主管部门
rules.audience: 查询某一具体手续日期者
rules.statement: Choose the correct academic year, semester and responsible office; retain any tentative status.
rules.qualifications: 区分正式、暂定、历史安排及个人time-ticket；不能以索引抓取时间当生效时间。

rules.summary_zh: 冲突或已过窗口须停下复核
rules.audience: 查询选课及手续窗口者
rules.statement: Resolve year or notice conflicts before treating a deadline as current.
rules.qualifications: S16标题与正文有学年冲突；本草案不发布具体截止日或宣称窗口仍开放。

rules.summary_zh: 休学应在加退课期结束前申请，教学期后不受理
rules.audience: 拟申请TPG休学者
rules.statement: Apply by the end of the add/drop period; applications submitted after the teaching period are not considered.
rules.qualifications: 通过AIMS的Student Record→My Applications→Leave of Absence提交；证明可在提交后4个日历日内补传。程序add/drop与费用Week 2分界分开核当年专业日历。

rules.summary_zh: 休学至少一整学期／term，每次不超一学年
rules.audience: 按适用硕士条例申请休学者
rules.statement: Leave must last at least one full semester or term; each application covers at most one academic year and the usual cumulative maximum is four semesters.
rules.qualifications: 保留normally；超四学期需Dean例外批准。休学计入最长修读年限，不能默认延长；不擅自添加暑期不计入的结论。累计已用时长与复学手续须由SGS核实。

rules.summary_zh: 休学晚申请须分A/B与Summer收费
rules.audience: TPG休学申请及相关学期费用核对
rules.statement: Late leave attracts 50% in Weeks 3–6 and 100% from Week 7 in Semesters A/B; Summer uses Week 3 and Week 4 onward respectively.
rules.qualifications: A/B按学分收费须与最低两学分金额取较高值。SGS细则对Summer也写最低额，FO暑期表未重复此项，不能自行视为豁免；早申请continuation fee另见R40。实际课程与特别批准另核。

rules.summary_zh: 退学须在通知后10工作日内清结义务
rules.audience: 拟终止TPG学业者
rules.statement: Clear outstanding matters within 10 working days after withdrawal notification; notices during or after the examination period take effect next semester.
rules.qualifications: 10工作日为清结欠费、借阅等，并非审批耗时；通常按AIMS提交日生效，考试期内／后转下学期。SGS与非本地说明对离境时限起算用语不同，不据此推算个人离境日。

rules.summary_zh: 退学也有50%／100%收费分段
rules.audience: TPG正式退学者及其适用收费学期
rules.statement: Withdrawal by the end of Week 2 normally incurs no tuition; late withdrawal follows different Semester A/B and Summer fee bands.
rules.qualifications: A/B第3–6周50%、第7周起100%；Summer第3周50%、第4周起100%。SGS细则列最低两学分，FO暑期表未重复该脚注，需核口径；接受费不退，其他退费按费种及正式生效时点另核。

rules.summary_zh: 付款表须保留flat／per-credit及两次账单
rules.audience: 2026/27 TPG按适用付款表及本人账单核对
rules.statement: The 2026/27 schedule distinguishes flat-fee payments from per-credit first and second statements, and separately lists Summer Term 2027.
rules.qualifications: 日期见下方结构化表；按学分收费还区分2019或以前届别的两学分预缴、2020起届别的分期抵扣。不是通用三个截止日；申请休学／退学等待结果时仍需核付款义务，不能自行停付。

rules.summary_zh: 签证可能需8周或更久，材料不全不处理
rules.audience: 适用ADMO非本地新生签证通道者；TPG须另核SGS入口
rules.statement: The published visa guidance warns processing may take eight weeks or longer and incomplete applications cannot be processed.
rules.qualifications: 这是处理估计而非获批保证；不能从首次发件日推算固定完成日。先核SGS／ADMO适用通道、接收、完整材料与正式决定，勿套用于所有签证类别。

rules.summary_zh: KLNT硕士渠道：新生资格、非本地优先、抽签
rules.audience: 2026/27新入学全日制硕士
rules.statement: KLNT eligibility is for newly admitted full-time master’s students in 2026/27; non-local applicants receive priority and allocation is by lottery.
rules.qualifications: 2026-05-27原定截止已过；当前补申请／床位未确认。优先权和合资格都不等于保证分配；全年床位及两期付款另看offer。

rules.summary_zh: MOS资格不限于新生，但新生优先
rules.audience: 全日制在读硕士；2026/27申请渠道
rules.statement: MOS accepts full-time master’s students and prioritises new 2026/27 entrants; oversubscription may be resolved by lottery.
rules.qualifications: 不要将KLNT只限新生的资格搬来MOS；MOS页面明确新生提交方式，旧生入口须问SRO。房型取决于供应，不能承诺PG楼或床位。

rules.summary_zh: MOS当年专表按人、学期及资助类别收费
rules.audience: 2026/27 MOS双人房对应资助类别的住宿者
rules.statement: The 2026/27 MOS fee table is per person per semester: HK$15,550 for UGC-funded and HK$19,450 for non-UGC-funded programmes.
rules.qualifications: 已核Hall 13及14–17双人房2026/27专表全文；不是全年或整间房价。空调、洗衣及寝具另计；全年床位分两期付款，仍按实际offer／账单确认。旧年总览价不用来替代专表。

rules.summary_zh: 召回的15日规则有短借例外
rules.audience: 普通流通借阅且受到召回者
rules.statement: Recall rules exclude loans of 15 days or less; a recall requires return within 15 days or by the original due date, whichever is earlier.
rules.qualifications: 条文另保障最低15日使用期；不能简化成收到召回后必可再借15日。以系统新日期核对；ILL、HKALL及其他资料另查专门规定。

rules.summary_zh: 三日宽限不是借期延长
rules.audience: 普通／召回资料且适用该宽限条文者
rules.statement: A three-calendar-day grace period is not an extension; if exceeded, fines run from the actual due date.
rules.qualifications: 未收到或未读通知不自动免罚；不将三日规则扩展至所有保留资料或媒体。资料类型、闭馆日与现行罚率仍需核对。

rules.summary_zh: 续借会受预约、罚款和权限阻断
rules.audience: 支持续借的资料及借阅人
rules.statement: Renewal dates run from the renewal date; holds, long-overdue items, fines exceeding HK$30 or suspended borrowing privileges can prevent renewal.
rules.qualifications: 超过HK$30不能改成大于等于；短借、媒体及表列保留资料不可续借。累计上限从首次借出计算，新日期从续借当天计；失败不延长有效到期日，须按期归还。

rules.summary_zh: 常规主轮援助限特定本科群体
rules.audience: 2026/27 CityUHK Financial Assistance Scheme主轮
rules.statement: Eligibility requires local, full-time, UGC-funded undergraduate status and genuine financial need.
rules.qualifications: 不能扩展至TPG；本轮2026-09-25 17:00已截止。迟交或不完整申请无合理解释通常不受理；未确认第二轮，不能承诺重新开放。

rules.summary_zh: 非本地紧急援助另有分流入口
rules.audience: 非本地全日制、发生紧急经济需要者
rules.statement: The schemes list a separate emergency fund for non-local full-time students with emergency financial need.
rules.qualifications: 指向Jennifer and Haywood Cheung Emergency Fund，须再核基金细则与TPG资格；获studentship研究生临时贷款及本地ENLS不能与之混同。概览不是个人符合资格的结论。

rules.summary_zh: 本地紧急援助全年可提出但受资金限制
rules.audience: 本地全日制突发经济困难学生；具体基金适用性待核
rules.statement: Emergency assistance may be sought year-round by eligible local full-time students, subject to funding and an SDS appointment.
rules.qualifications: 全年可提出不代表随时有资金；个别基金清单仍标2025/26，2026/27名单及TPG适用性待核，不能套常规本科主轮截止日。

rules.summary_zh: 非网上加退课与负荷调整截止不同
rules.audience: 2026/27 Semester A硕士相关手续
rules.statement: Non-web add/drop runs from 10 August to 7 September 2026; exceeding/reduced-load applications run from 10 August to 12 September 2026.
rules.qualifications: 截至2026-10-26两窗口均已结束；页面没有统一每日截止时刻则不补造。迟交或例外走SGS核实，不能承诺可以办理。

rules.summary_zh: 网上选课分两轮并看个人time-ticket
rules.audience: 2026/27 Semester A硕士网上选课
rules.statement: Round one covers programme-related courses; round two covers all courses, with individual time-tickets and a published round-two end of 7 September 2026 at 23:30.
rules.qualifications: Elder Academy、内地校区、外出交换／合作项目、visiting等类别不适用网上选课；课程还须WEB=Y并满足先修及课程限制。“all courses”是轮次范围，不保证人人可选所有课。个别time-ticket另核；窗口已结束，S16冲突仍待核。

rules.summary_zh: 考试期不能替代个人考试表
rules.audience: 2026/27 Semester A硕士期末考试
rules.statement: The published examination period is 7–19 December 2026; individual timetables and seat assignments must still be checked.
rules.qualifications: 时间表列教学第10周公布；截至2026-10-26考试期尚未开始。不能据整个考试期推断某门课程考试日，天气改期及课程例外另核。

rules.summary_zh: 首学期休学与退学分别核对签证担保后果
rules.audience: 非本地学生签证持有人，首学期休学或正式退学
rules.statement: First-semester leave for non-local student-visa holders withdraws visa sponsorship; withdrawal of studies has its own notification and immigration consequences.
rules.qualifications: SGS休学页列首学期休学从生效日起4周或签证到期取早；退学页列从通知提交日起4周或签证到期取早。两者起算不同；个人条件与现行移民要求须向SGS／相关主管机关核实。

rules.summary_zh: 早申请休学仍有continuation fee，Summer为零
rules.audience: TPG；具体学期、入学状态与批准条件需补齐
rules.statement: An approved early leave carries a continuation fee of HK$1,500 per semester, with no continuation fee in Summer.
rules.qualifications: 申请于Week 2结束前提交且随后获批准，才按相应条件收continuation fee；不要求审批也在Week 2前完成。Summer零continuation fee不代表其他费用全免，实际账户另核。

rules.summary_zh: 申请程序时点与费用分界不能混为同一日期
rules.audience: TPG；具体学期、入学状态与批准条件需补齐
rules.statement: Keep the procedural add/drop timing separate from the Week 2 fee boundary and map each to the applicable programme calendar.
rules.qualifications: 申请程序与收费分界分别核专业日历；SGS收费周次以周日为每周首日。非标准校历课程按专业规定，不直接用选课截止换算休学截止。

rules.summary_zh: MOS退宿须区分主动退出与校方启动的退款例外
rules.audience: 2026/27 MOS住宿者，原因及费种须明确
rules.statement: The MOS refund section distinguishes student-initiated early withdrawal from University-initiated withdrawal; the confirmation fee remains non-refundable.
rules.qualifications: 学生因休学等主动提早退出一般不退；校方因学术／纪律等启动的条款列住宿费按日比例退、确认费除外。同页末尾又概括已付不退，需SRO核例外，不能丢掉该分支或自行计算。

rules.summary_zh: 当年申请所列政府资助者，休学／退学须另行书面通知
rules.audience: 本学年申请Local Student Finance Scheme或Non-means-tested Loan Scheme者
rules.statement: Applicants to the listed finance or loan schemes must immediately notify SFAA in writing of leave or withdrawal; assistance may be adjusted.
rules.qualifications: 这项通知独立于大学账户清结；资助超额须按要求退还。不适用者跳过，申请状态不明先核实，不将本义务扩展到所有学生。
